examples.text_zh: 这条路的下坡很容易看出。

examples.text_en: She is of a good family by descent.
examples.text_zh: 按血统来说，她出身于一个好家庭。

examples.text_en: We could descry a small house near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 我们望见海边有一座小房子。

examples.text_en: They descry the town from the top of the road.
examples.text_zh: 他们从路的最高处望见了那座镇子。

examples.text_en: Someone tried to desecrate the very small grave and stone.
examples.text_zh: 有人试图亵渎那座很小很不起眼的墓石。

examples.text_en: They feared the soldiers would desecrate the church.
examples.text_zh: 他们担心士兵会亵渎这座教堂。

examples.text_en: The deserter left the army in the night.
examples.text_zh: 这名逃兵在夜里离开了军队。

examples.text_en: They call him a deserter and a bad man.
examples.text_zh: 他们称他为逃兵和坏人。

examples.text_en: His desertion of the army was the talk of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他从军队逃跑的事成了全镇的话题。

examples.text_en: The desertion of the group was a great loss.
examples.text_zh: 这群人的离弃是巨大的损失。

examples.text_en: They desiccate the food to keep it safe.
examples.text_zh: 他们把食物干燥处理以便保存。

examples.text_en: Such air can desiccate the green land.
examples.text_zh: 这样的空气会使绿地变得干燥。

examples.text_en: A good job is a desideratum for most people.
examples.text_zh: 一份好工作对大多数人来说是迫切想要的。

examples.text_en: Good health is the great desideratum of our time.
examples.text_zh: 健康是我们这个时代最迫切的需求。

examples.text_en: The official designation of the small area changed.
examples.text_zh: 这个小区域的官方名称最近变了。

examples.text_en: Her new designation as team leader pleased all of us.
examples.text_zh: 她被任命为队长让所有人都很高兴。

examples.text_en: A good home is desirable for every family.
examples.text_zh: 对每个家庭来说，一个好住所都是令人向往的。

examples.text_en: It is desirable to have a strong team.
examples.text_zh: 拥有一支强大的队伍是可取的。

examples.text_en: She was desirous of a better life.
examples.text_zh: 她渴望过上更好的生活。

examples.text_en: They are desirous of a good result.
examples.text_zh: 他们渴望得到一个好结果。

examples.text_en: The desolate land had no water and no life.
examples.text_zh: 这片荒凉的土地既没有水，也没有生命。

examples.text_en: They live in a desolate area near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在海边一片荒凉的地方。

examples.text_en: They will despatch the goods on Monday morning.
examples.text_zh: 他们将在周一上午发出这批货物。

examples.text_en: The office must despatch these letters before noon.
examples.text_zh: 办公室必须在中午前把这些信寄出。

examples.text_en: The desperado had no home and no name.
examples.text_zh: 这个亡命之徒没有家，也没有名字。

examples.text_en: They call him a desperado in the town.
examples.text_zh: 镇上的人都称他为亡命之徒。

examples.text_en: They despoil the land of all its gold.
examples.text_zh: 他们掠夺这片土地上所有的黄金。

examples.text_en: The army will despoil the town in the night.
examples.text_zh: 军队将在夜里劫掠这座小镇。

examples.text_en: The despoiler took everything of value from us.
examples.text_zh: 掠夺者夺走了我们所有值钱的东西。

examples.text_en: He was seen as a despoiler of our forests.
examples.text_zh: 他被视为破坏我们森林的掠夺者。
